notes.views.note_create(request)[source]

Create a note from submitted form data.

A valid POST request saves the note and redirects to the notes list. Otherwise, render the form, including any validation errors.

request (HttpRequest) – Incoming HTTP request.

Returns:

The rendered form or a redirect to the notes list.

HttpResponse

notes.views.note_delete(request, pk)[source]

Show a confirmation page or delete a note after confirmation.

A POST request deletes the note and redirects to the notes list. Other requests render the confirmation page.

Parameters:

  • request (HttpRequest) – Incoming HTTP request.

  • pk (int) – Primary key of the note to delete.

Returns:

The confirmation page or a redirect to the notes list.

Return type:

HttpResponse

Raises:

Http404 – If no note exists with the given primary key.
